summary: Defines GMPLS routing and signaling extensions for networks in which routers take part in several different data plane switching layers or regions under one control plane. This is the multi-layer and multi-region network (MLN/MRN) case. It builds on the existing GMPLS framework.

eli5.summary: Imagine one traffic office directing cars, trains, and boats at once. This explains how a single control system can manage a network that has several different kinds of switching.
